description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order to declare that the cess shall be charged, levied and paid on export of Natural Rubber latex, etc., w.e.f. 15.06.2016
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the issuance of a legal/regulatory order under Section 14 of the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No. 40 of 1979. It establishes new cess (tax) rates on specific exported goods, which constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement. While it mentions Minister Malik Samarawickrama, it does so only to establish the authority making the order and does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities or personnel changes, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
